source_claims.quote: SafeGuard-VL-RL is a policy-aware visual safety guardrail model built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for robust unsafe-image detection.

description.text: SafeGuard-VL-RL is a policy-aware visual safety guardrail model built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for robust unsafe-image detection. This model is part of our CVPR 2026 paper: Towards Policy-Adaptive Image Guardrail: Benchmark and Method.

output_type.quote: Provide your reasoning and final judgment (Safe/Unsafe).

use_claim.quote: SafeGuard-VL-RL is a policy-aware visual safety guardrail model built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for robust unsafe-image detection.

warning.quote: The model's judgments are policy-dependent and should not be used as the sole arbiter of content safety in production systems without human oversight.

serving.notes: config.json max_position_embeddings is 128000. tokenizer_config.json model_max_length is 131072. max_new_tokens 512 is from the card usage example, not generation_config.json. The chat template accepts image and video tokens. The Stage-2 script system string is different: "A conversation between User and Assistant. The user asks a question, and the Assistant solves it."

evaluation_reported.text: Table 4 row Ours (RL), which the paper defines as SafeGuard-VL-RL: LlavaGuard 71.78, UnsafeBench 62.39, SafeEditBench 45.59, safety overall 59.92, general overall 57.02. The prose says SafeGuard-VL-RL attains 71.78 on LlavaGuardBench and moves UnsafeBench from 41.71 to 62.39, with general overall 57.02.

discrepancies: Inventory methods are grpo|sft. The card says this checkpoint is Stage-2 GRPO only, without Stage-1 SFT. The dataset and the parent match.
